headline: Oil prices jump 5% after U.S. revokes Iran oil sanctions waiver following ship attacks
summary: Oil prices rose 5% after the US revoked a waiver on Iran oil sanctions, following reports of oil and gas tankers being fired upon. Stocks fell, and semiconductor shares weighed on markets.
why: Brent is the global benchmark for crude oil, and Gulf shipping routes carry a large share of seaborne oil supply. Sanctions and attacks in the region directly affect crude prices and energy costs.
why_moved: The revoked sanctions waiver and reported attacks on tankers raised concerns about supply through Gulf shipping routes. Traders bid up crude while equities fell.
